readme:
# Codex Bridge 0.4.0

配套新版 Aide 中，进入插件即可操作 **安装、启动、停止、卸载、生成密钥**。不需要另下 EXE、打开独立管理器网页或填写连接码。管理组件随 Aide 完整发行包提供；桥接程序只在你点击安装后安装。

**配套 Aide PR #616 仍在发布校验中。请使用包含该改动的新完整发行包；只更新插件或只换旧发行包里的镜像，不足以启用这条路径。** 旧 Aide 保留独立管理器兼容入口。

## 使用

1. 本机已有 Node.js 18+，Codex CLI 已安装并登录。
2. 用新版完整发行包启动 Aide，安装/升级本插件并打开工作台。
3. 点击安装、启动。点击生成密钥后，将显示的地址与密钥填入 Aide 模型提供商的加密设置。
4. 获取模型并测试。模型目录可读不代表当前账号具备推理权限。

卸载只移除桥接程序，保留配置、密钥及 Codex 登录。已有密钥会复用，不会自动轮换或覆盖模型提供商。管理操作仅允许人工在工作台点击，模型没有任意宿主命令能力。读取额度只查询账户剩余百分比及重置时间，读取失败显示不可用。

## English

On the companion Aide full distribution containing PR #616, the plugin provides **Install, Start, Stop, Uninstall, Generate key** without a separate manager download/page or pairing code. Update both the Aide launcher and image. That companion Aide release is still undergoing publication checks; older Aide keeps standalone-manager compatibility.

Host Node.js 18+ and a signed-in Codex CLI remain prerequisites. Copy the explicitly requested, masked API key into Aide encrypted model-provider settings. Uninstall retains configuration, keys and Codex login. No arbitrary host shell commands, automatic provider overwrite or fabricated quota.

## 验证范围 / Acceptance

Windows/macOS/Linux CI passed. Linux synthetic lifecycle and rendered plugin controls, six-platform component builds, and macOS launcher/container connectivity passed. Windows native launcher x64/ARM64 cross-builds passed. Windows 10/11/Server desktop acceptance and real-account inference/quota are not claimed. Native components are unsigned previews.

[Release](https://github.com/skyelan1999/aide-pkg-CodexBridge/releases/tag/v0.4.0) · [Aide integration PR #616](https://github.com/skyelan1999/aide/pull/616) · [Central issue #615](https://github.com/skyelan1999/aide/issues/615)
